plugin.name: EH CRM
plugin.author: boudy-elhegaz
plugin.description: CRM for a real-estate marketing company: data entry (CSV with template + review before registration) → equal distribution to the sales team → each sales rep calls and logs the result → sales manager monitors and can transfer a batch of leads to another employee. Permissions: 3 = data entry, 4 = sales, 5 = sales manager (2 = admin above).
